newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise four bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise four bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated December 6 to commercial banks worth four billion Lebanese pounds, down from last week's five billion.
The Bank sold 45-day CDs worth two billion pounds compared with four billion last week. It sold 60-day CDs worth two billion pounds, compared with one billion last week.
Interest rates on the 45- and 60-day CDs were unchanged from last week's 12.25 percent and 13.00 percent respectively.
